name: photo-caption
title: PhotoCaption
description: A photo in; a caption and accessibility alt text out, written by the on-device vision model. Streamed, editable, copyable, and handed back as alt text.

files.content:
export { PhotoCaption, photoCaptionLabels, type CaptionEmptyProps, type CaptionFieldProps, type CaptionOutput, type PhotoCaptionIcons, type PhotoCaptionLabels, type PhotoCaptionProps, type PhotoCaptionStyles } from './photo-caption'
export { usePhotoCaption, imagePart, type CaptionImage, type PhotoCaptionState, type UsePhotoCaptionOptions } from './use-photo-caption'
export { captionInstructions, cleanAlt, cleanCaption, parseCaption, type CaptionTone, type ParsedCaption } from './prompts'

docs: Needs a provider with the `vision` capability. Pass `image` (uri, or base64 from expo-image-picker) or let the user take or choose one; `onUseAlt` receives the edited alt text.

budget.strategy: One image plus a short instruction; a single streamed reply of two labelled lines (caption, alt) parsed as it arrives.

limits: Not on iPhone yet: Apple's model takes images from iOS 27, and the provider package Ondai uses does not pass them on yet. Runs on Gemini Nano (Prompt API, beta) or a cloud model.
